entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: This petition has been filed for quashing of the FIR No.228/2022 dated 23.04.2022, PS Vasant Kunj South, under Sections 498A/406 IPC, on the ground that the parties have settled their disputes vide a Settlement Agreement dated 08.05.2022 which is on record of this Court.

As per the settlement, since the marriage between petitioner No.1 and respondent No.2 which was solemnized on 05.02.2017 has now broken down due to disputes and differences and the parties are undergoing a divorce proceeding by mutual consent, a full and final settlement amount of Rs.16 Lakhs had been agreed to be paid by the petitioner No.1 to respondent No.2.
4.
Both, the petitioner No.1 and respondent No.2 are present in the Court and are duly identified by the parties and their counsels.

It, however, transpires that while an amount of Rs.8 Lakh has already been paid, the balance amount is to be paid at the time of passing of decree of divorce in the second motion petition, which is yet to be scheduled before the Trial Court.
5. In view of the same, list on 25.04.2023 for the parties to report on compliance with the settlement and their decree of divorce.
6. Order be uploaded on the website of this Court.
